messages:
emily: Heads up — PR #5221 is up for review. It's a focused migration of our function-calling examples to the new JSON envelope shape (top-level envelope + explicit meta). Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5221 :eyes:

jason: Nice. I'll do a quick pass on the TS snippets. Any acceptance criteria?

sophia: Main schema change: we moved from returning raw objects to an envelope:
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "result": { /* actual output */ },
    "meta": { "model": "gpt-xx", "parse_version": 2 }
  }
}
```
Need examples for nullable arrays and an explicit parse-fallback example.

matt: SDK note: Python and JS code examples need the new `unwrap_envelope=True` param (or `unwrapEnvelope: true` in JS). Small snippet:
```python
# python
resp = client.call_function(name="summarize", input=text, unwrap_envelope=True)
print(resp.result.summary)
```

ravi: Guardrails: add a short section showing how to validate `meta.parse_version` and fall back to the old parser if missing. Also call out the performance trade-offs for prefix caching when envelope sizes vary.

emily: Action items:
- sophia: add nullable-array example + parse-fallback snippet
- jason: update TS snippets under /docs/sdk/js/examples/*
- matt: update python snippets and add a short FAQ blurb about `unwrap_envelope`
- ravi: add guardrail note and a 1-paragraph explanation of caching effect
- emily: sweep links and merge after 1 LGTM

jason: I can own the JS changes. I'll open a small follow-up PR if anything needs breaking out. planning to push by EOD.

sophia: Quick note: the structured-output.md page currently links to the old schema at /docs/specs/old-tool-schema.md — that's a 404. I'll drop a patch to replace it with /docs/specs/json-envelope.md.

matt: One question: do we have a canonical example for tool calling vs function calling using this envelope? I can draft one showing `tools: [...]` under `envelope.result` so parsers don't confuse it with the top-level routing keys.

emily: Yes please — a single canonical example will help downstream SDKs. Put it in the examples folder and reference it from the migration guide.

docs-bot: link-checker: ran on PR #5221 — 2 warnings (relative link to /docs/guide had a trailing slash) and 1 info. No broken links reported after the changes in sophia's branch.

emily: Cool. If nobody objects I'll merge after jason's LGTM. Thanks all :rocket:
